narrative_purpose: The cold-open anchor for the pa'li: an elephant-massed six-limbed runner laid out so the reader sees the contradiction the chapter opens on - enormous bulk carried on slender, athletic legs, with the middle limb pair, long nectar-feeding neck, and flank breathing slits all visible.
subject: A complete direhorse specimen presented in profile on a dark bench: a large six-limbed herbivore with three pairs of limbs - elongated front and rear pairs built for running, and a smaller middle pair set between them - all strikingly slender for the body's bulk. A long muscular neck leads to a small streamlined head with a tubular sucker-mouth. A pair of breathing slits (opercula) sits low on the flank behind the neck. The leg bones glow faintly from within, lightweight and threaded with darker carbon-like fibre.
scene: A field-laboratory bench at night, the animal posed mid-stance, the room beyond falling into dark haze.
camera: A clean side-on profile view, the whole body sharp from nose to hindquarters, bench receding into soft focus.
light: Cool clinical lamp from above plus a faint bioluminescent glow within the porous leg bones; deep indigo shadow under the body.
palette: Void-indigo background, cool bone-grey and pale teal on the body, faint cyan glow in the leg bones, one scarce amber pinpoint at the eye.
style: Painterly naturalist specimen plate, hand-painted texture, museum clarity.
detail_level: Crisp on the three limb pairs, the slender leg bones, the long neck and sucker-mouth, and the flank opercula; bench and background dissolving into haze.
composition: The animal in full profile filling the horizontal frame, slight elevation, dark negative space above for breathing room, 3:2 landscape.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette with bioluminescent key from within the bone. Same dark glowing-specimen mood as the chapter cover.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no cartoon or anime style
